sampling: Replay each complete trajectory once from discard at every 0..120 score pair; first crossing determines winner; count all preterminal phase visits in current-dealer orientation.
limitations: Recorded decisions are fixed, not reoptimized for each hypothetical score.
Phase cells condition on different visited histories; adjacent-cell reversals alone do not prove a counting bug.
Sparse observed cells retain raw frequencies; uncertainty and unsupported cells remain in the source database and this provenance.
